_doc: Edit this list by hand. Per product: id (unique, no spaces), name, category (a new category = just use a new name), description, mrp (original price), price (selling price; discount % is calculated), images[] (first = card image), variants[{name,hex,images[]}] (optional, variant-specific photos), material, colour, care, sku, stock (<=5 shows 'Only N Left', 0 = Out of Stock + Notify Me), available (false forces Out of Stock), badge (text or empty), newArrival/bestSeller/trending/sale (true/false).
